title: Sparkle
blurb: Glittering chimes layered thick, the sound-design equivalent of glitter itself and about as easy to remove once applied. Sparkle stings come out of cartoon and advertising libraries where they signal magic, cleanliness or transformation, so they turn up in fairy-tale animation and adverts for bathroom cleaner with equal frequency. Online, the same clip has been thoroughly repurposed for irony. Lay it over something deeply unglamorous and the contrast does the joke for you. Straight uses still land, especially over a reveal or a before-and-after cut.
origin: A shimmering magical sparkle sound effect.
